cells.text: This was an application for a group of variations. Type II (B.II.e.1.b.2) - Change to the immediate packaging of the biological finished product, by addition of 45 mg solution for injection in a vial (EU/1/24/1844/004).

The SmPC sections 1, 2, 3, 4.2, 4.4, 5.1, 6.3, 6.4, 6.5, 6.6, 8 have been updated as follows: To include details of the 45 mg vial presentation. Annex A, Labelling and Package Leaflet have been updated accordingly.

blocks.label: footnote
blocks.text: 1 Notifications are issued for type I variations and Article 61(3) notifications (unless part of a group including a type II variation or extension application or a worksharing application). Opinions are issued for all other procedures.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: footnote
blocks.text: 2 A Commission decision (CD) is issued for procedures that affect the terms of the marketing authorisation (e.g. summary of product characteristics, annex II, labelling, package leaflet). The CD is issued within two months of the opinion for variations falling under the scope of Article 23.1a(a) of Regulation (EU) No. 712/2012, or within one year for other procedures.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: footnote
blocks.text: 3 SmPC (Summary of Product Characteristics), Annex II, Labelling, PL (Package Leaflet).
